current_stack_and_alias_boundaries: Every PUSH and RET independently requires actual current SS stack-address size 32, 32-bit operand decoding and normal completion. No earlier stack predicate is reused.

64 selects FS only for the explicit memory operands at C07C05 and C07C3E. The implicit PUSH store and RET read use actual current SS; no segment base, descriptor, mapping or nonaliasing relationship is established.
PUSH at C07C05 reads current FS:0 before the stack decrement/store; PUSH at C07C2B reads current SS:[EBP-8] before its stack decrement/store.
LEA at C07C14 and C07C3B computes 32-bit offsets without reading memory or translating a segment. Assigning a numeric EBP value does not authenticate a frame or register ABI.
SUB ESP,EAX uses current register values with modulo-32 arithmetic. Its flags arise from subtraction; XOR clears CF/OF, computes SF/ZF/PF, and leaves AF undefined.

Stores may alias subsequent memory reads, including the candidate return word. The C07C3E store to FS:0 may alias current SS:ESP before C07C44 RET. RET reads the then-current stack word; an original caller return destination is unproven.
C07C90 is only a pushed immediate; E15590 is only an encoded DS memory offset; FS:0 is only an encoded segment offset. Their cells, providers, prototypes and semantic roles were not queried.
The saved __SEH_prolog4 name and false no_return/is_thunk flags remain metadata. No library identity, cookie, exception-chain role, OS service, calling convention or frame is authenticated.
